findings.desc: `first-screen-clean` / `first-screen-drift` / `build-and-smoke` 的 recorded evidence 只由 validation-protocol smoke 证明 handler 输出与 build 通过；`packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:795-930` 直接调用 createCheckHandlers/createDoctorHandlers，没有实际经由 dist CLI 执行 `check`/`doctor`。对于 verificationIntent.type=cli 的首屏文本与 JSON surface，这会留下 CLI entrypoint wiring 未被本 story 证据直接覆盖的空档。

`no-wrapper-assumption` 已在 plan 里声明为 “B-39d9 only claims core readiness; B-3e9a records wrapper proof” (`.koala/story/actives/B-39d9/plan.md:48`)，但当前 verificationEvidence 把它记成 manual_transcript 且未附 file/command/source ref。该 intent 的结论方向是对的，不过证据载体还不够可追踪，建议后续把这条 evidence 直接绑定到 handoff 文档或 review artifact。

runtimeMode conflict handling misses the packaged-runtime branch: classifyRuntimeMode short-circuits on KOALA_DESKTOP_PACKAGED_RUNTIME before checking for local node_modules/.bin/koala shadowing (packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:260-303), so conflicting signals are reported as packaged-runtime instead of diagnostic-only/unknown. Repro command: node --input-type=module ... runRuntimeEnvironmentChecks(...) with KOALA_DESKTOP_PACKAGED_RUNTIME=1 plus a project-local node_modules/.bin/koala and a different active CLI path returns {"mode":"packaged-runtime","source":"packaged-runtime"}. This violates the CHK-001 unknown-conflict contract and is not covered by validation-protocol-smoke.ts:772-787, which only tests non-packaged conflicts. Fix: detect conflicting local-bin signals before accepting packaged-runtime, and add a packaged-runtime conflict smoke case.
